summary: Describes how an OSPF router can advertise its local addresses in OSPF Traffic Engineering extensions. Other routers need these addresses to compute traffic-engineered MPLS paths to a router's addresses, but previously only addresses tied to TE links were advertised. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Routers announce more of their own street addresses to neighbors, so others can plan a route that ends right at their door.

questions: advertise router local addresses in ospf te
how to compute te lsp to a router address
